en: Blank Cards are used in {f 0 1 2}Sacrifice{SAUT}Fusions{f 0 1 0} in the Velvet Room. Use a Blank{SAUT}Card to carry over a {f 0 1 2}specific skill{f 0 1 0} from{SAUT}the sacrificed Sub-Persona to the one{SAUT}you want to strengthen.
Only skills that are {f 0 1 2}highlighted on the{SAUT}skill list{f 0 1 0} can be carried over.

You can sometimes obtain a Blank Card{SAUT}when you {f 0 1 2}defeat a Rare Shadow or an{SAUT}FOE{f 0 1 0}. They're quite valuable; you won't{SAUT}need to let a great skill go to waste just{SAUT}because you're sacrificing a Sub-Persona.
